name: M1 Measurement-aware Segmentation with Dual-axis Auxiliary Supervision
position_in_project: Independent method experiment parallel to E3. Tests whether measurement-aware auxiliary supervision (two double-angle axis heads on the final decoder feature) improves early-trimester cardiac-axis measurement over E0 scratch. Scratch init: no mid-trimester data, no pretrained weights. Not a transfer experiment.
hypothesis: Adding lightweight Card/Reference double-angle regression heads on the final decoder feature, trained jointly with the E0 segmentation loss (L = L_seg + 0.1*(L_card+L_ref)/2), improves Full Angle measurement versus the E0 from-scratch baseline, without changing the segmentation/inference pipeline.

network_architecture.backbone: E0 PlainConvUNet unchanged (encoder + decoder + 7-channel segmentation output + deep supervision)
network_architecture.inference_path: network(x) returns ONLY the original segmentation logits; auxiliary heads are ignored at inference, post-processing and geometry unchanged

aux_heads.input_feature: final decoder stage feature (same tensor that feeds seg_layers[-1])
aux_heads.init: independent random init; original segmentation head init identical to E0 (aux heads do not perturb E0 parameter init)

loss.segmentation: E0 inherited (CompoundLoss: Dice + CE, with deep supervision) - unchanged
loss.axis: L_axis = 1 - dot(q_pred_normalised, q_gt); double-angle q(theta) = [cos 2theta, sin 2theta]
loss.auxiliary: L_aux = (L_card + L_ref) / 2, each averaged over its own valid samples
loss.invalid_label_handling: a missing/NaN axis label only masks that axis's auxiliary loss; the case is NOT dropped from segmentation training; batches with no valid aux labels contribute zero aux loss (no NaN)

training.trainer_parent: nnUNetTrainer_300Epochs (E0 trainer), unchanged except aux heads + M1DataLoader + train_step aux term
training.init: scratch from epoch 0 (no mid-trimester data, no pretrained weights)
training.learning_rate: inherited E0 default (0.01, PolyLR over 300 epochs)
training.augmentation: inherited E0 default nnUNetv2 2D (rotation, mirroring, scaling, gamma; no elastic). Orientation labels transformed with the actual SpatialTransform/MirrorTransform parameters via M1DataLoader + dual_axis_augmentation.
training.gpu_note: GPU 3 reserved for E3; M1 trained on physical GPU 1

evaluation.geometry_pipeline: frozen E0 geometry (ID4/ID5 OBB weighted card axis; ID6->ID1 centroid reference axis)
evaluation.internal_protocol: five-fold OOF; each fold predicts its own validation set (621)
evaluation.measurement_failures: 1 internal (ref_axis_unavailable); same case also fails under E3; E0/E2 valid

headline_verdict: Neutral / no demonstrated clinical gain. Internal Full Angle is significantly WORSE than E0 (+0.181 deg, 95% CI [0.023, 0.359]) and E3 (+0.168 deg, [0.009, 0.337]); external is statistically null versus E0 (-0.048 deg) and E3 (-0.001 deg). The auxiliary heads collapsed to a near-constant (mean-direction) predictor; see README/report for the GAP diagnosis.

aux_loss_vs_constant_baseline.note: Constant-predictor baseline = 1 - |E[e^{i 2 theta}]| on each fold's training set (no image read). Cosine loss range is [0,2].
aux_loss_vs_constant_baseline.interpretation: After 300 epochs the auxiliary loss is only ~0.06 below a no-image constant predictor (L=0.73 ~ 37 deg axis error, chance ~45 deg).

aux_bias_direction_deg.note: Normalised direction of each fold's aux_heads.*.fc.bias = the network's default output axis angle. Label marginal means: Card 90.0 deg, Ref 87.3 deg.

diagnosis.root_cause: AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1) collapses the [B,32,H,W] decoder feature to a 32-d global vector, discarding the spatial layout that defines an axis direction. Both heads therefore reduce to a near-constant mean-direction predictor. The 0.1x aux gradient still back-propagates into the shared decoder, acting as a direction-agnostic (≈90 deg prior) regulariser rather than useful axis supervision.

archived_case_level_policy: Case-level CSVs (with real uids) stay in local/. Only anonymous aggregate CSVs and a hashed failure record (sha256[:16], scheme documented) are archived. No weights, prediction masks, TAR, or training logs are uploaded.
